baseline_models.focus_anchor: ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ... أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Trusting assent becomes intentional conduct directed against corruption; recompense answers that conduct, and the final negation denies cutoff or diminution of its extension.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the inward commitment that begins the mechanism.
Intentional doing converts inward assent into purposive conduct.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives the conduct a reparative direction.
Recompense for work makes the outcome an answer to conduct rather than an arbitrary prize.
Otherness and negation make the qualifier deny a property of the recompense.
Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the denied property and yields unbroken continuance.

changed_reading.before: A doctrinal exception followed by a promise of endless reward.
changed_reading.after: A causal sequence in which settled assent becomes deliberate repair and receives a recompense whose extension cannot be cut or depleted.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse places interpersonal work and recompense beside a negated image of a benefaction made weighty by recounting it. The reward therefore preserves the recipients' security and dignity instead of becoming social leverage over them.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the relational state that the reward preserves.
Dealing between people opens a social and transactional dimension in the deeds.
Reconciliation supplies a concrete form of socially restorative action.
Recompense establishes a positive answer to the work.
Negation excludes the following favor-image from the reward.
A favor made burdensome by reminder supplies what is excluded, so benefaction cannot be weaponized as debt.

changed_reading.after: The reward is also free of humiliating reminders and creditor-like leverage; it secures the recipient rather than burdening the recipient with favor-debt.

baseline_models.mechanism: Images of wage and recompense invite a calculable exchange, but the negated branch of measured weight destabilizes strict equivalence. The deeds remain answerable while the award exceeds a metered wage.

activation_trace.role: Pay for work supplies the expectation of a calculable wage.
Recompense reinforces the exchange frame.
Negation reverses the quantifying expectation generated by wage and recompense.
Measured or weighed quantity supplies the exploratory property being denied.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds earn a fixed compensating quantity.
changed_reading.after: Good deeds receive a real answer, but the reward cannot be reduced to a weighed, metered equivalent of the work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening places severance and connected extension on a cosmic scale. Against that field, the focus qualifier does more than promise long duration: it marks recompense as a continuity that is not severed when created containers split, stretch, and change state.

activation_trace.role: Splitting and opening supply the scene's maximum image of severance, against which reward-continuity is tested.
Drawing something lengthwise until it connects supplies the counter-motion of extension.
Negation explicitly blocks the following cutoff-image from characterizing the reward.
Cutoff and diminished extension name the failure that the reward survives.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a split sky and an extended earth before closing on a negated property of reward.
The final exception follows a sequence in which every created container changes state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic severance, connected extension, and a focus branch of cutoff or diminution; I infer that the final negation marks continuity surviving those ruptures. A live alternative is the narrower idiom 'unending' with no cosmic mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The reward continues for a very long or limitless time.
changed_reading.after: The reward is the relation of continuity that remains unsevered even across the cosmic disassembly staged by the opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human movement toward the Lord is defined as arduous expenditure, while the favorable account opens into ease. The final reward then negates both being cut short and losing sustaining force, so non-ending becomes experiential as well as temporal.

activation_trace.role: Toilsome striving supplies the depleting mode of the human journey.
Ease opening after hardship supplies the first reversal of toil.
Self-exertion or taking trouble keeps the cost of action visible inside the focus verse.
Recompense answers the expenditure rather than extending toil indefinitely.
Cutoff through diminution makes exhaustion one possible way an experience ends, and that ending is negated.
Sustaining strength or its loss shifts inexhaustibility from the reward's duration to its lived power.

structural_cues: The cognate pair كَادِحٌ كَدْحًا intensifies expenditure before the later sequence of easy account, joy, and reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arduous effort, ease after hardship, and the focus alternatives of cutoff and lost sustaining strength; I infer an arc from depletion to inexhaustible participation. A live alternative restricts ease to accounting and ممنون to duration alone.

changed_reading.before: An endless reward waits after a life of work.
changed_reading.after: The reward is inexhaustible to inhabit: unlike the journey's toil, it neither spends the recipient's sustaining strength nor ends through weariness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The record fixes a judgment and the account counts what was done, so moral answerability is not erased. Yet the focus combines wage and recompense with a negated measured weight, opening a threshold where assessment is exact but award is not exhausted by equivalence.

activation_trace.role: A written fixing that establishes judgment supplies the ledger's binding side.
Counting and accounting supply explicit quantification of conduct.
Ease after difficulty makes passage through the account possible without making the account unreal.
A worker's pay sets up the expectation of commensurable compensation.
Recompense confirms that conduct receives an answer.
Negation turns the final measured-weight branch into a limit the award exceeds.
A weighed or measured quantity supplies the limit denied of the reward.

structural_cues: The right-hand record leads to easy account and joyful return before the final nominal allocation لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding record, explicit counting, wage, recompense, and a measured-weight branch under negation; I infer that exact assessment and non-equivalent generosity coexist. A live alternative reads measured weight as irrelevant and ممنون only as cut off.

changed_reading.before: The record totals deeds and pays the corresponding amount.
changed_reading.after: Deeds are genuinely recorded and assessed, but the resulting reward crosses beyond what the ledger can meter as an equivalent wage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obligation, binding record, and account create a juridical field around the focus's work and recompense. Negating the branch of favor-recounting then makes the grant covenantally secure rather than discretionary largesse that can later be invoked against its recipients.

activation_trace.role: A fixed obligation or due supplies juridical necessity at the opening.
Writing that establishes judgment gives the later recompense a recorded framework.
Accounting supplies adjudication rather than an ungrounded favor.
Pay for work links the promised good to recognized action.
Recompense supplies the focus verse's positive juridical allocation.
Negation excludes the patronizing mode from the allocation.
Recounted benefaction supplies the excluded mechanism of leverage and revocable social debt.

structural_cues: The two record scenes are judicially parallel, while the focus ends with a direct dative allocation to the excepted group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies due-ness, binding judgment, account, work, recompense, and negated favor-recounting; I infer a grant secured within the announced order rather than largesse held over the recipients. A live alternative takes these legal cues as scene-setting only and keeps the phrase at 'unreproached' or 'unending.'

changed_reading.before: A benefactor gives an endless favor to the faithful.
changed_reading.after: The faithful receive a publicly secured recompense that cannot be converted into patronizing debt or withdrawn through a recital of favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding failure-chain carries recited meaning to hearers but not into embodied lowering; truth is covered while contents remain held within. The focus reverses that blockage: trusting assent is put to work in fitting acts, making the conjunction between faith and deeds a transmission from interior reception to outward response.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supply meaning that reaches the audience but, in the negated construction, stops short of response.
Humble lowering supplies the embodied response explicitly absent from the preceding group.
Covering truth supplies the blockage between reception and acknowledgment.
Holding meaning in the heart supplies the concealed interior whose contents are known.
Trusting assent supplies genuine inward reception in the excepted group.
Putting something to work turns received truth into operative conduct.
Fitness or suitability makes the outward act answer appropriately to what was inwardly received.

structural_cues: Negated recitation-response, covering, and inward containment immediately precede the positive relative clause ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟.
The focus uses two coordinated perfect verbs rather than an identity label alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation without lowering, covered truth, held inner content, trusting assent, and putting something to work; I infer that the focus conjunction marks successful passage from inward reception to embodied response. A live alternative treats faith and deeds as two independent qualifications.

changed_reading.before: Faith and good deeds are two items on an eligibility list.
changed_reading.after: The excepted group is defined by permeability between interior and exterior: trusted truth becomes operative, fitting action instead of remaining covered or merely contained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispersed things are gathered, a cycle reaches completion, and the addressee traverses state after state. The final reward's non-cutoff and sustaining strength can therefore be read as invariance across transitions, not merely duration inside one final state.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed things supplies recomposition before the sequence of stages.
Completion and even coherence supply a phase reaching fullness.
One thing riding upon another supplies the superposed structure of successive states.
State after state supplies the explicit temporal or ontological transition.
Non-cutoff lets the reward remain continuous across rather than merely within stages.
Undiminished sustaining force lets the reward preserve efficacy through each transition.

structural_cues: Twilight, gathering night, completing moon, and emphatic traversal form a progression of changing phases before the final exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, completion, superposition, state-after-state traversal, and focus images of cutoff and sustaining force; I infer a reward stable through phase change. A live alternative places the reward only after all stages and gives it no trans-stage function.

changed_reading.before: The reward begins in the last state and then continues.
changed_reading.after: The reward names a continuity and sustaining relation that does not fail as the person passes from state to state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to announce punishment forces a joy-opening news branch into collision with pain. The immediate exception then supplies the positive destination withheld by that irony: an allocated, uncut recompense becomes the delayed genuine glad news.

activation_trace.role: News that opens the complexion with joy supplies a positive expectation that the painful object initially frustrates.
Punitive pain supplies the ironic collision inside the announcement.
Hurt and suffering sharpen the reversal of the expected glad-news effect.
Settled security supplies the affective state proper to genuine glad news.
Allocated recompense supplies the positive content deferred across the verse boundary.
Uncut continuance lets the delayed positive announcement retain its force.

structural_cues: The exception إِلَّا immediately follows the ironic announcement of painful punishment.
The punishment clause is imperative, while the focus answers with a settled nominal allocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a joy-opening news branch joined to pain and an immediate positive exception; I infer delayed lexical fulfillment across the verse boundary. A live alternative treats the adjacency as ordinary contrast with no repair of the news-root's positive expectancy.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely exempts believers from the punishment just announced.
changed_reading.after: The verse also completes the announcement's suspended positive sense: after ironic tidings of pain, the uncut recompense is the genuine glad news reserved for the exception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material branches rather than the ordinary moral and economic senses. It remains anchored through the focus words for sound deeds and recompense, while a context branch independently supplies bone-knitting after fracture. Render it only as a repair analogy, and retain the crookedness in the recompense branch as a caution against claiming perfect lexical equivalence.

activation_trace.role: A scratch or bite-mark supplies material damage left by the journey's toil.
Bone knitting after fracture supplies an independent context image of bodily reunion.
Soundness against corruption gives the focus a direct repair anchor.
A broken part knitting, even with residual crookedness, turns recompense into restorative joining.
Negated cutoff lets the repaired continuity hold rather than split again.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds earn payment after toil.
changed_reading.after: The toil that marks or fractures the traveler is answered by sound-making deeds and a recompense imagined as knitting damaged continuity back together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant split mapping for the sky cue and a provisioning branch of focus غ ي ر even though the surface construction grammatically negates. It remains anchored in focus soundness, reward, غَيْرُ, and non-cutoff, with a coherent sky-earth-nurture sequence. Render it as ecological branch resonance, never as a replacement gloss for غَيْرُ.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies the surprising sky-to-growth trigger from the split mapping.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply the governing growth process.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receiving substrate for replenishment.
Connected increase that supplies another with aid or material gives replenishment its continuing motion.
Soundness and repair anchor the ecological mechanism in the deeds themselves.
Provisioning, watering, and setting right echo the context ecology inside the focus qualifier without displacing its negating syntax.
Non-cutoff makes the provision recurrent and non-depleting.

changed_reading.before: The reward is a static possession that never ends.
changed_reading.after: The reward can also be imagined as continuously replenishing provision: a nurturing answer to acts that restore soundness, more like recurring growth than a stored stock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it places the positive branch of free release under the explicit negation of غَيْرُ. It remains anchored because work and recompense supply compensation, while the context supplies binding judgment and punitive restraint. Render it only as a legal-polarity experiment: the reward is positively adjudicated rather than mere amnesty, not as a settled translation of مَمْنُونٍ.

activation_trace.role: A written act establishing judgment supplies the adjudicative frame.
Restraint, prevention, or weaning supplies detention as the immediate contrast.
Pay for work supplies a positive compensatory basis rather than bare release.
Recompense makes the focus outcome an award, not only escape from restraint.
Negation reverses the free-release branch and creates the legal polarity.
Free release without compensation supplies what the exploratory polarity says the outcome is not merely.

changed_reading.before: Believers are simply spared or released from punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their outcome is not exhausted by discretionary amnesty from restraint; the verse positively allocates adjudicated recompense for operative faith.

strongest_changes: غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ moved from generic endlessness into several coexisting mechanisms: continuity through rupture and stages, freedom from favor-debt, preservation of sustaining strength, and reward beyond measurement.
The context changed faith and deeds from an eligibility checklist into successful passage from inwardly held assent to embodied, fitting response.
The collision between glad-news imagery and painful punishment made the focus reward a plausible delayed fulfillment of genuine glad news.
summary.what_was_special: The richest activations came from branch collisions rather than broad themes: severance versus extension, exact accounting versus an unweighed award, toil-scratches and fracture-knitting versus soundness, and joyful announcement versus pain. These mechanisms remain concurrent rather than being merged into one final gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus syntax clearly negates, but it does not decide here whether cutoff, favor-recounting, measured quantity, or loss of sustaining force should dominate the branch field.
The fracture and ecological models depend on branch-distant material analogy, and the ecological model also depends on a non-dominant split mapping; both require explicit qualification.
The stage sequence can mark temporal passage, moral transformation, ontological transition, or several of these at once, so the trans-stage reading should remain plural.
